blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While massive, closed-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) set strong benchmarks for document understanding, their dependence on commercial APIs limits adoption in institutional archives due to data autonomy concerns, recurring costs, and the environmental footprint of hyperscale computing. This is especially acute in heritage digitization, where documents include historical handwriting, domain-specific terminology (e.g., jewelry, prehistory, architecture), and non-standard layouts requiring high-dimensional structured extraction. We present a comparative study of eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B parameters) for Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-to-structure across three university heritage collections. Given a document image, models must extract text and generate schema-compliant JSON, enabling automatic validation and downstream use. We evaluate models under a constraint-aware protocol across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings, measuring extraction fidelity and structured-output quality using Character Error Rate (CER), Approximate Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS*), and mean Average Precision F1 (mAP-F1). Against a fine-tuning baseline, we further test the independent impact of (i) hyperparameter optimization, (ii) classical image preprocessing (illumination flattening, denoising, and CLAHE), and (iii) multi-stage training. Finally, we analyze the trade-off between dataset-specific fine-tuning and a single multi-dataset checkpoint, where joint training enables one model to operate across collections but can shift performance between datasets. Overall, we show that carefully adapted VLMs with up to 7B parameters can provide a sustainable, private, high-performing alternative to manual transcription or commercial black-box systems, and we offer actionable guidance for heritage institutions seeking institution-controlled OCR-to-JSON extraction.
blocks.zh: 虽然大规模、闭源的Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)为文件理解设定了强有力的基准,但由于数据自主性、经常性成本以及超规模计算的环境足迹,对商业API的依赖限制了机构档案中的采用。 这在遗产数字化中尤为尖锐,文件包括历史笔迹,特定域名词(如珠宝,史前,建筑),以及需要高维结构提取的非标准布局. 我们提出一个比较研究,对三个大学遗产收藏的8个光学字符识别(OCR)到结构的开源轻量级VLM(最多7B参数)进行比较研究。 鉴于文件图像,模型必须提取文本并生成符合计划的JSON,从而能够自动验证和下游使用。 我们利用字符误差率(CER),近似常态化Levenstein相似性(ANLS*),以及平均精度F1(mAP-F1),在0射、数射和微调设置下,对限制-意识协议下的模型进行评估,测量提取忠性和结构输出质量。 根据微调基线,我们进一步测试(一) 超参数优化、(二) 古典图像预处理(照明平整、去诺定和CLAHE)和(三) 多阶段培训的独立影响。 最后,我们分析了数据集特定微调与单一多数据集检查站之间的权衡,在这两个检查站,联合培训使一个模型能够跨收集系统运行,但能够在数据集之间转变性能。 总的来说,我们显示,经过仔细调整的具有最多7B参数的VLM可以提供一种可持续的,私人的,高性能的替代人工抄录或商业黑盒系统,我们为寻求机构控制的OCR到JSON提取的遗产机构提供可操作的指导.

blocks.en: OCR is no longer only about reading plain text. In many real applications, the goal is to extract information from documents and return it in a structured form that can be searched, validated, or directly used by downstream systems. While standard benchmarks often focus on commercial forms like invoices or ID cards, practitioners in archives, collections, and museums face the distinct challenge of digitizing specialized historical records. In this work, we focus on OCR -to-structure: given a document image, the model should output the extracted content as a structured JSON object (see fig. 1 for a representative example from an archival inventory).
blocks.zh: OCR不再仅仅是读取纯文本. 在许多真正的应用中,目标是从文档中提取出信息,并以结构化的形式返回,可以被搜索,验证,或者被下游系统直接使用. 标准基准往往侧重于发票或身份证等商业形式,而档案、收藏和博物馆的从业人员则面临着专门历史记录数字化的明显挑战。 在这部作品中,我们注重OCR——到结构:给一个文档图像,模型应该将所提取的内容输出为结构化的JSON对象(见图一. 档案目录中的代表性例子为1个)。

blocks.en: Recently, VLM have shown strong capabilities on document understanding tasks. However, many state-of-the-art models are large, closed-source, and accessible only through commercial cloud API . For public archives and collections, this reliance on external providers presents significant barriers regarding data autonomy, i.e., the ability of an institution to maintain sovereignty over its own digital assets. Furthermore, the massive energy consumption of hyperscale models raises concerns about the environmental sustainability of large-scale digitization projects. In practical settings such as on-device systems, cost-sensitive cloud services, or scenarios with limited GPU ( GPU ) resources, smaller models are often preferred. This motivates our study of lightweight VLM : models with up to 7 billion parameters that can be deployed locally on institutional hardware. While these models are attractive for deployment, it is still unclear how reliable they are at producing correct and well-structured OCR outputs, especially when the output must follow a highly specialized archival schema.
blocks.zh: 最近,VLM在文件理解任务上表现出了强大的能力. 然而,许多最先进的模型是大型的,封闭源代码,只能通过商业云API获取. 就公共档案和收藏而言,这种对外部提供者的依赖对数据自主性,即一个机构维持对自身数字资产的主权的能力,构成重大障碍。 此外,超规模模型的大量能耗引起了对大规模数字化项目的环境可持续性的关切。 在实际环境下,如在线设备系统,成本敏感云服务,或GPU(GPU)资源有限的情景,往往偏好较小的模型. 这激励了我们对轻量级VLM的研究:最多70亿个参数的模型,可以在当地部署在机构硬件上. 虽然这些模型对部署具有吸引力,但目前还不清楚这些模型在生产正确和结构完善的OCR产出方面有多可靠,特别是在产出必须遵循高度专业化的档案计划的情况下。

blocks.en: In this paper, we present a comparative study of eight lightweight VLM for structured OCR , evaluated on records from three specialized university collections: the Erlangen-Prehistoric dataset (prehistoric artifacts at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg), the Pforzheim Jewelry dataset (jewelry records at HS Pforzheim), and the Regensburg Scalalogy dataset (architectural staircase forms at OTH Regensburg). We evaluate all models in zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning settings. Importantly, we follow a fair protocol that respects each model’s interface: some models only accept a fixed OCR -style instruction (e.g., a single keyword prompt such as “ OCR ”), while others allow custom prompts that explicitly request structured JSON extraction. Based on the overall results across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning evaluations, we select the top three models and investigate further improvements via additional studies. Finally, we analyze single-dataset versus multi-dataset fine-tuning to understand cross-collection transfer and deployment trade-offs.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了对结构化的OCR的八个轻量级VLM的比较研究,该研究根据三个专业大学收集的记录进行评估:埃尔兰根-史前数据集(FAU Erlangen-纽伦堡的史前文物),普福斯海姆珠宝数据集(HS Pforzheim的杰维尔里记录)和雷根斯堡斯卡拉克数据集(OTH Regensburg的考古楼梯表)。 我们以零发,少发,微调的设置来评价所有模型. 重要的是,我们遵循一个尊重每个模型界面的公平协议:有些模型只接受一个固定的OCR风格指令(例如,一个单一的关键词提示,如“OCR ” ) , 而另一些模型则允许明确要求结构化 JSON 提取的自定义提示 。 基于零发,少发,微调评价的总体结果,我们选择了前三种模式,并通过进一步研究来调查进一步的改进. 最后,我们分析单一数据集与多数据集微调,以理解交叉收集转移和部署取舍.

blocks.en: We investigate practical questions that matter for institutional deployments. First, we study whether multi-stage training provides consistent gains over standard single-stage fine-tuning for OCR -to- JSON extraction. Second, we test whether hyperparameter optimization improves structured OCR performance. Third, we analyze whether classical image preprocessing can help models produce cleaner and more accurate JSON .
blocks.zh: 我们调查对机构部署至关重要的实际问题。 首先,我们研究多阶段培训是否为OCR至JSON提取标准单阶段微调提供了一致的收益。 第二,我们测试超参数优化是否改善结构化的OCR性能. 第三,我们分析古典图像预处理是否能够帮助模型生产更清洁更准确的JSON.

blocks.en: Overall, our goal is to provide clear guidance for practitioners from GLAM ( GLAM ) who want to use small VLM for document OCR and structured extraction. We benchmark the models, identify strong lightweight choices, and study practical adaptation strategies that improve reliability without requiring external commercial API or excessive resources.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的目标是为GLAM(GLAM)的从业人员提供明确的指导,他们想使用小型VLM来文档OCR和有条理取出. 我们确定模型的基准,确定强大的轻量级选择,并研究实用的适应战略,以提高可靠性,而不需要外部商业API或过多的资源。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are: • We benchmark eight lightweight VLM ( ≤ \leq 7B) on three specialized archival collections, evaluating structured OCR -to- JSON as a private, sustainable alternative to commercial API . • We propose a constraint-aware evaluation protocol that accounts for diverse model interfaces (fixed vs. custom prompting) in zero-shot settings. • We evaluate the impact of fine-tuning, multi-stage fine-tuning, hyperparameter optimization, and classical image preprocessing on the top-performing models to quantify their effect on extraction accuracy and schema adherence.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Traditional OCR and Document Understanding. Classical OCR systems such as Tesseract [ 27 ] rely on multi-stage pipelines (e.g., binarization, layout analysis, segmentation, recognition) and are brittle under complex layouts and degraded images. Structured extraction is often addressed by combining OCR with downstream KIE ( KIE ) models. LayoutLM [ 32 ] and successors LayoutLMv2 [ 33 ] and LayoutLMv3 [ 15 ] improved multimodal document understanding, but still depend on external OCR and typically require task-specific fine-tuning with labeled bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 传统的OCR和文档理解. 经典的OCR系统如"魔方" [27] 依赖于多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 结构取出常常通过将OCR与下游KIE(KIE)模型相结合来解决. 布局LM [32] 和后继者布局LMv2 [33]和布局LMv3 [15] 改进了对多式文件的理解,但仍然依赖于外部OCR,通常需要使用有标签的边框对特定任务进行微调.

blocks.en: End-to-End Document Understanding without OCR . To remove OCR dependence, Donut [ 17 ] maps document images directly to structured sequences, and Pix2Struct [ 18 ] pretrains on webpage screenshots to transfer to document tasks. Nougat [ 7 ] targets academic documents (PDF-to-Markdown), while DAN [ 9 ] addresses handwriting recognition without explicit line detection. GOT- OCR 2.0 [ 29 ] unifies diverse OCR tasks and supports structured outputs (e.g., Markdown, L a T e X ). However, these OCR -free approaches are typically evaluated primarily for accuracy rather than schema compliance required by institutional databases.
blocks.zh: 在无OCR的情况下实现端到端文件理解. 为了去除OCR的依赖性,Donut [17] 将图像直接映射到结构化的序列上,而Pix2Struct [18] 在网页截图上预告可以传输到文档任务上. Nougat [7] 瞄准学术文件(PDF-to-Markdown),而DAN [9] 则处理笔迹识别,而没有明确的行检测. Got-OCR 2.0 [29] 统一了各种OCR任务,并支持结构化输出(如Markdown,L a T e X.). 然而,这些无风险风险评估方法通常主要按照机构数据库所要求的准确性而不是计划遵守情况进行评估。

blocks.en: Vision-Language Models for Document Tasks. General-purpose vision-language models VLM have also been applied to document understanding. LLaVA [ 21 ] popularized visual instruction tuning, and InstructBLIP [ 11 ] and BLIP-2 [ 19 ] improved vision-language alignment. For documents, mPLUG-DocOwl [ 35 ] applied unified instruction tuning, and Qwen-VL [ 3 ] and successors support high-resolution inputs. Recent models such as Qwen2-VL [ 28 ] and InternVL [ 8 ] have advanced performance on DocVQA [ 23 ] and FUNSD [ 16 ] , but evaluations largely emphasize question answering rather than JSON validity and schema compliance. Most recently, the importance of open weights for data autonomy has been increasingly recognized. This has driven the introduction of powerful models like Pixtral [ 1 ] and DeepSeek OCR [ 30 ] , which achieve state-of-the-art document understanding and allow for open deployment.
blocks.zh: 文件任务远景-语言模型. 通用视觉语言模型VLM也被用于文件理解. LLaVA [21] 通俗化的可视化指令调谐,并指导tBLIP [11]和BLIP-2 [19] 改进了视觉语言调谐. 对于文档,mPLUG-DocOwl [35] 应用了统一的指令调音,而Quen-VL [3] 和后继者支持高分辨率输入. 最近的一些模型,如Qune2-VL [28]和InternVL [8],在DocVQA[23]和FUNSD[16]上都有先进的性能,但评价主要强调问题答案,而不是JSON的有效性和计划合规性. 最近,开放权重对于数据自主的重要性得到越来越多的承认. 这推动了Pixtral [1]和DeepSeek OCR [30]等强大的模型的引入,这些模型实现了最先进的文档理解并允许公开部署.

blocks.en: Lightweight VLM and Efficient Adaptation. Resource constraints motivate smaller VLM and efficient adaptation. LoRA ( LoRA ) [ 14 ] and QLoRA ( QLoRA ) [ 12 ] enable parameter-efficient fine-tuning on accessible hardware. Lightweight VLM include PaliGemma [ 6 ] , Phi-3-Vision [ 24 ] , MiniCPM-V [ 34 ] , SmolVLM [ 22 ] , and Florence-2 [ 31 ] . For pure, specialized text extraction, models like PaddleOCR-VL [ 10 ] have recently gained traction. However, their rigid interfaces often do not allow for the complex conversational prompting required to recognize the complex structures inherent in collection records. Furthermore, systematic comparisons of lightweight models under controlled conditions remain scarce, particularly for producing valid structured outputs (e.g., JSON ) on complex archival records.
blocks.zh: 轻量级VLM和高效适应. 资源限制促使人们采用较小的自愿适应和高效率的适应办法。 LoRA (LORA) [14]和QLORA (QLORA) [12] 启用参数高效的可访问硬件微调. 轻量级 VLM 包括 PaliGemma [6],Phi-3-Vision [24],MiniCPM-V [34], SmolVLM [22],和佛罗伦萨-2 [31]. 对于纯的,专门的文本取出,PaddleOCR-VL[10]等模型最近获得了牵引力. 然而,它们的僵硬界面往往无法使复杂的对口提示能够识别收集记录所固有的复杂结构。 此外,在控制条件下对轻量级模型的系统比较仍然很少,特别是在复杂的档案记录上产生有效的结构化产出(例如JSON)。

blocks.en: Research Gap. Despite significant progress, several gaps remain in the literature. First, most benchmarks evaluate large-scale models, leaving uncertainty about how lightweight VLM ( ≤ \leq 7B parameters) perform on structured OCR tasks while maintaining institutional data sovereignty. Second, evaluations typically report accuracy metrics without measuring JSON validity or schema adherence, which are critical for archival integration. Third, comparisons across models rarely account for interface constraints: some models accept only fixed OCR prompts, while others support custom instructions for structured extraction. Fourth, the interaction between classical image preprocessing techniques and modern VLM is underexplored. It is unclear whether preprocessing still benefits end-to-end models. Finally, practical adaptation strategies such as multi-stage training and hyperparameter optimization have not been systematically studied for OCR -to- JSON extraction. Our work addresses these gaps through a controlled benchmark of eight lightweight VLM , a fair evaluation protocol respecting model constraints, and studies on preprocessing, hyperparameter optimization, and multi-stage training.
blocks.zh: 研究差距:尽管取得了重大进展,但文献中仍存在一些差距。 首先,大多数基准评价了大规模模型,对轻量级VLM( \leq 7B参数)如何在保持体制数据主权的同时执行结构化OCR任务留下了不确定性. 第二,评价通常报告准确度衡量标准,而不衡量JSON的有效性或是否符合计划,这对于档案整合至关重要。 第三,跨模型的比较很少考虑到接口的制约:有些模型只接受固定的OCR提示,而有的则支持结构提取的自定义指令. 第四,古典图像预处理技术与现代VLM之间的相互作用被低估. 尚不清楚预处理是否仍然有利于端到端模式。 最后,尚未系统地研究诸如多阶段培训和超参数优化等实际适应战略,以便从OCR到JSON提取。 我们的工作通过8个轻量级VLM的控制基准、尊重模型限制的公平评价协议、关于预处理、超参数优化和多阶段培训的研究来解决这些差距。

blocks.en: We evaluate our pipeline on three distinct datasets sourced from German university collections in archaeology, design history, and architecture. These datasets were developed in close collaboration with the respective institutions to support their ongoing efforts in digitizing historical records. They represent a spectrum of real-world archival challenges, ranging from historical handwritten text to printed catalog cards and complex, nested architectural forms. Table 1 summarizes the statistics and splits for each collection.

Erlangen-Prehistoric Dataset. This dataset originates from the Collection for Prehistory and Protohistory at the Friedrich-Alexander Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg. We processed 308 pages of the historic “Inventarbuch der Anthropologisch Prähistorischen Sammlung” , which is publicly available through the collection’s digital archive. 2 2 2 https://www.uf.phil.fau.de/abteilungen/sammlung/inventarbuecher/ Ground-truth transcriptions were generated using Gemini3 and subsequently manually verified; the transcriptions are published via Zenodo. 3 3 3 https://zenodo.org/records/20668191 .
The documents are predominantly handwritten with printed headers or labels. Figure 1 shows an example, along with its target data structure. Each record describes archaeological or historical artifacts with fields including inventory number, dimensions, find location, find date, and descriptive text. The handwritten nature of most entries, combined with historical script variations and occasional degradation, makes this dataset particularly challenging for OCR systems.

这些文件主要是手写并有印刷头或标签. 图1显示了一个实例及其目标数据结构。 每一份记录都描述了考古或历史文物,有田地,包括库存编号、尺寸、找到位置、找到日期和描述性文字。 大多数条目的手写性质,加上历史脚本的变异和偶尔的退化,使得这个数据集对OCR系统特别具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Pforzheim Jewelry Dataset. This dataset comprises 590 digitized inventory cards from the historical teaching aids collection at the Pforzheim University, School of Design. The records come from the KUPFER research project, which investigates the collection’s history and significance. 4 4 4 KUPFER–Die Lehrmittelsammlung der Kunstgewerbeschule Pforzheim zwischen Medienarchäologie und Innovationstransfer (2023–2027), funded by the Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space (BMFTR) ( https://designpf.hs-pforzheim.de/kupfer ) They describe jewelry from different periods and cultural areas, acquired by the Pforzheim School of Decorative Arts between 1879 and 1970. The inventory cards were derived from historical books when the objects were moved on permanent loan to the Pforzheim Jewellery Museum around 1980. The task requires extracting a dense 17-field schema, including material, weight, and insurance value. An example is provided in fig. 2 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Definition and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务定义和计量

blocks.en: Task Definition. Given a document image, the model must output a JSON object that follows a fixed, dataset-specific schema. Erlangen-Prehistoric dataset and Pforzheim Jewelry dataset use flat key-value dictionaries with string values, while Regensburg Scalalogy dataset uses a larger schema with nested objects and boolean fields. If a field is missing or illegible, we treat it as empty: text fields should be an empty string and boolean fields should be false. The JSON output can be deterministically rendered to Markdown for inspection and manual auditing.
blocks.zh: 任务定义。 鉴于一个文档图像,模型必须输出一个遵循固定的,数据集特定方案设计的JSON对象. 厄兰根-史前数据集和普福斯海姆珠宝数据集使用有字符串值的平面密钥-值词典,而雷根斯堡斯卡拉克数据集则使用有嵌入对象和布尔字段的更大的斯图. 如果一个字段缺失或无法辨认, 我们视它为空: 文本字段应该是空字符串, 布尔字段应该是假的 。 JSON的产出可以确定,可以交给Markdown进行检查和人工审计。

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics. We report CER , ANLS ∗ , and mAP-F1 , and additionally track JSON validity (parsable dict outputs). Collectively, these metrics disentangle content quality from structured output reliability: CER and ANLS ∗ measure how well the extracted values match the reference (even when formatting degrades), whereas mAP-F1 and JSON validity quantify whether the output is a usable JSON object under a strict parsing requirement.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度。 我们报告CER、ANLS *和mAP-F1,并额外跟踪JSON的有效性(可解码输出)。 这些衡量标准将内容质量与结构化的输出可靠性区分开来:CER和ANLS * 测量提取值与参考值的相匹配程度(即使在格式降解时),而mAP-F1和JSON有效性则在严格的解析要求下量化输出是否是可用的JSON对象.

blocks.en: Canonical ground truth and parsing policy. For each sample, the ground truth is stored as a fixed canonical JSON string (consistent formatting and a fixed key order). For a model output, we first attempt to parse the raw generation as JSON . If parsing succeeds, metrics are computed on the parsed object, and for string-based metrics we serialize the parsed prediction into the same canonical JSON format as the ground truth. If parsing fails, we compare the raw prediction text directly against the canonical ground-truth JSON string, reflecting downstream usability requirements.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-10-21). Canonial ground truth and explaining policy. 克勞克·克勞克所著"克勞克通報". 对于每个样本,地真被存储为固定的Canonic JSON字符串(一致的格式和固定的密钥顺序). 对于模型输出,我们首先尝试 将原始的一代描述为JSON。 如果解析成功,则在解析对象上计算出度量衡,对于基于字符串的度量衡,我们把解析的预测序列化为与地表真象相同的克诺克JSON格式. 如果解析失败,我们直接将原始预测文本与犬形地真JSON弦作比较,反映下游可用性要求.

blocks.en: CER . We compute CER against a fixed canonical ground-truth JSON string (with a consistent key order and formatting as stored). If the model output parses as JSON , we serialize the parsed prediction into the same canonical format and compute CER between the two JSON strings. If parsing fails, we compute CER between the raw model output text and the canonical ground-truth JSON string. Lower CER indicates higher overall output fidelity.
blocks.zh: CER. (中文(简体) ). 我们根据固定的犬形地真JSON弦来计算CER(有一致的密钥顺序和被存储的格式). 如果模型输出解析为JSON,我们把解析的预测序列化为同一种犬科格式,并在两个JSON字符串之间计算CER. 如果解析失败, 我们计算原始模型输出文本和 Cononical 地面真实 JSON 字符串之间的CER 。 核证排减量较低表明总产出的忠诚度较高。

blocks.en: ANLS ∗ . If both prediction and ground truth parse as JSON , we apply structured ANLS ∗ [ 26 ] directly to the nested objects. These are then scored with ANLS similarity using threshold τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 (scores below τ \tau are set to 0). If the prediction is not valid JSON , we fall back to a string-level ANLS -style similarity between the raw output text and the canonical ground-truth JSON string (fixed order/format), penalizing invalid structured outputs while still giving a graded content score.

For space constraints, we do not include JSON -validity columns in the main result tables. Across our experiments, JSON validity stays in the range of ≈ \approx 95 %–100 % for Gemma-3, Phi-3.5-Vision, and Qwen2.5-VL across settings, but remains much lower for Donut, Florence-2, and PaddleOCR-VL even after fine-tuning. blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup and Methods
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置和方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate eight vision-language models (200M–7B parameters) spanning encoder-decoder and instruction-tuned architectures ( Table 2 ). Models marked with † \dagger only accept fixed OCR -style prompts and therefore do not support few-shot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价8个跨越编码器-解码器和指令调制结构的视觉语言模型(200M-7B参数)(表2)。 标有 \\dagger 的模型只接受固定的 OCR 风格的提示, 因此不支持少发的演示 。

blocks.en: Table 2: Overview of the eight VLMs evaluated. Models marked with † \dagger only accept fixed OCR-style prompts and do not support few-shot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 表2:所评价的8项自愿活动概述。 标有 \\dagger 的模型只接受固定的 OCR 风格的提示, 并且不支持几发的演示 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Constraint-aware prompting
blocks.zh: 4.2 有约束意识的提示

blocks.en: A key challenge in benchmarking diverse VLM is that they differ in their input interfaces and prompting flexibility. Donut-Base, Donut-CORD, Florence-2-Large, and PaddleOCR-VL are restricted to fixed OCR -style prompts or task-specific tokens (e.g., <s_cord-v2> , <OCR> ) and do not support arbitrary natural-language instructions.
blocks.zh: 衡量不同VLM的一个关键挑战是,它们在输入界面上存在差异并激发出灵活性。 Donut-Base,Donut-CORD,Florence-2-Large,和PaddleOCR-VL被限制在固定的OCR-风格的提示或任务特定符号(例如:<s_cord-v2>,<OCR>),不支持任意的自然语言指令.

blocks.en: In contrast, Nanonets-OCR-s, Gemma-3-4B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B accept custom prompts, enabling schema-guided structured extraction. To ensure a fair comparison, we evaluate each model under its supported interface. For fixed-prompt models, we apply minimal post-processing to raw generations (strip wrapper text/chat prefixes, trim whitespace and code fences) before attempting JSON parsing.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,纳诺涅茨-OCR-s,Gemma-3-4B,Phi-3.5-Vision,和Quen2.5-VL-7B接受自定义的提示,使有计划制导的结构取出成为可能. 为了确保进行公平的比较,我们在其支持的界面下对每个模型进行评价。 对于固定的即时模型,我们在尝试JSON解析之前,对生代应用了最小的后处理(strip slapper text/chat前缀,trim whitespace和代码栅栏).

blocks.en: 4.3 Zero-shot inference
blocks.zh: 4.3 零发推论

blocks.en: In the zero-shot setting, we provide no in-context demonstrations. For prompt-flexible models, the input prompt includes the target JSON skeleton (i.e., the exact field structure used in the ground truth) and requests that the output follows this schema. For fixed-prompt models, we use their designated OCR prompt tokens/keywords and evaluate the resulting generations after the same minimal post-processing. All evaluations use greedy decoding (temperature = 0) for deterministic outputs, with images resized according to each model’s native preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 在零射出的情况下,我们不提供任何内在的演示。 对于即时弹性模型,输入快取包括目标JSON骨架(即地真所使用准确的场结构),并请求输出遵循这个方案. 对于固定的即时模型,我们使用他们指定的OCR即时活字符/键入符,并在同样最小的后处理后评价产生的后代. 所有评价都使用贪婪的解码(温度=0)来进行定型输出,图像会根据每个模型的原生预处理来调整大小.

blocks.en: 4.4 Few-shot inference
blocks.zh: 4.4 少数镜头推断

blocks.en: Few-shot evaluation is applied only to models that support custom prompting (Nanonets-OCR-s, Qwen2.5-VL, Phi-3.5-Vision, and Gemma-3). We prepend k ∈ { 1 , 2 } k\in\{1,2\} image- JSON demonstrations sampled from the training set: ⬇ [ Image 1] -> { "field1" : "value1" , ...} [ Image 2] -> { "field1" : "value1" , ...} [ Query Image ] ->
In our experiments, k = 1 k=1 is used for the Pforzheim Jewelry dataset, while k = 2 k=2 is used for the Erlangen-Prehistoric and Regensburg Scalalogy datasets.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,克=1克=1用于普福兹海姆宝石数据集,而克=2克=2用于埃尔兰根-史前和雷根斯堡斯卡拉克数据集.

blocks.en: 4.5 Standard fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 4.5 标准微调

blocks.en: We fine-tune all evaluated models. For models below 1B parameters (Donut-Base, Donut-CORD, Florence-2-Large, and PaddleOCR-VL), we perform full-parameter fine-tuning. For larger models (Nanonets-OCR-s, Gemma-3-4B, Phi-3.5-Vision, and Qwen2.5-VL-7B), we use parameter-efficient QLoRA [ 12 ] on an NVIDIA V100 (32GB VRAM ( VRAM )), combining 4-bit quantization with LoRA adapters while keeping the base weights frozen. LoRA adapters are added to the attention and MLP layers. The best checkpoint is selected by lowest autoregressive validation CER and evaluated on the test set via autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了所有评估模型。 对于低于1B参数的模型(Donut-Base,Donut-CORD,Florence-2-Large,和PaddleOCR-VL),我们进行全参数的微调. 对于更大型的型号(Nanonets-OCR-s,Gemma-3-4B,Phi-3.5-Vision,和Quen2.5-VL-7B),我们在一款NVIDIA V100(32GB VRAM (VRAM))上使用有参数效率的QLORA[12],将4位的量子化与LORA适配器结合,同时使基重被冻结. LORA适配器被添加到关注层和MLP层. 最佳检查点由最低自递归验证CER选择,并通过自递归生成在测试集上进行评估.

blocks.en: 4.6 Additional Study Configurations
blocks.zh: 4.6 其他学习配置

blocks.en: Using the fine-tuning pipeline described above as the baseline, we conduct three additional studies to evaluate practical strategies for improving structured OCR performance. These studies are applied only to the selected top-3 models (selection criteria reported in Section 5 ) and are evaluated independently to isolate each contribution.
blocks.zh: 利用上述作为基线的微调管道,我们进行了另外三项研究,以评价改进结构化OCR性能的实际战略。 这些研究仅适用于选定的前3名模型(第5节中报告的选取标准),并经过独立评估,以隔离每项贡献.

blocks.en: Study 1: Hyperparameter Optimization. We compare the default fine-tuning configuration against an Optuna [ 2 ] -optimized configuration for each of the top-3 models. Optuna is used only to identify the best hyperparameters; these values are then plugged back into the same baseline fine-tuning code for the final training run. We run 20 trials using the TPE ( TPE ) sampler, optimizing validation CER . To reduce computational cost, each trial trains for 5 epochs, after which the best hyperparameters are used for a full training run.
blocks.zh: 研究1:超参数优化. 将默认的微调配置与Optuna [2] - 优化的每个前3型的配置进行比较. Optuna只用于识别最优的超参数;这些值再被插回同一个基准微调代码来进行最后的训练跑. 我们利用TPE(TPE)取样器进行了20次试验,优化了核证CER。 为了降低计算成本,每列试运行时间为5个世纪的列车,之后将使用最好的超参数来进行全程训练.

blocks.en: Study 2: Image Preprocessing. We evaluate whether classical image preprocessing improves model performance compared to using raw images. Our preprocessing pipeline consists of four sequential steps: 1. Illumination Flattening: Convert to grayscale, estimate background via morphological opening, and normalize to remove uneven lighting. 2. Denoising: Apply bilateral filtering (default) or Non-Local Means denoising to reduce noise while preserving edges. 3. CLAHE : Apply CLAHE on the luminance channel to enhance local contrast. 4. Letterbox Resize: Resize the image to a fixed canvas (e.g., 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ) with padding to preserve aspect ratio. We apply the full preprocessing pipeline on top of the baseline fine-tuning setup and compare performance against the same training/evaluation run using raw images.
blocks.zh: 研究2:图像预处理. 我们评价古典图像预处理是否比起使用原始图像改进了模型性能. 我们的预处理管道包括四个相继步骤: 1. 照明灯:转换为灰度,通过形态开口估计背景,并实现去除不均匀照明的常态. 2. Denoising:采用双边过滤(默认)或非本地手段去除噪声,同时保留边缘. 3. CLHE:在发光频道上应用CLAHE来增强本地对比. 4. 信箱大小调整:将图像大小调整为固定画布(例如:1024×1024 1024\times 1024)并加贴以保留相相比. 在基线微调设置之上,我们采用完整的预处理管道,并利用原始图像将业绩与同样的培训/评价进行比较。

blocks.en: Study 3: Multi-stage Training. We investigate whether curriculum-based multi-stage training [ 5 ] improves convergence and final performance compared to single-stage fine-tuning. The procedure is: 1. Warm-up: Fine-tune on the target dataset’s training split for a short warm-up phase using a higher learning rate (i.e., 3 × 3\times the base LR). This stage uses teacher forcing (supervised JSON targets) to quickly adapt the model to the document domain and the dataset-specific JSON style. 2. Refinement: Continue fine-tuning on the same dataset with the base learning rate for the remaining epochs. We run validation at each epoch and select the best model by the lowest validation CER (early stopping applied when validation CER stops improving for a patience period of N N epochs). We compare this two-stage schedule against a single-stage baseline trained for the same total number of epochs using cosine learning-rate decay.
blocks.zh: 研究3:多阶段培训。 我们调查基于课程的多阶段培训[5]与单阶段微调相比是否提高了趋同性和最终性能. 程序为: 1. 温暖: 对目标数据集的训练进行精细调整,采用高分速率(即3×3相差于基站LR)进行短期取暖阶段分出. 这个阶段使用老师强迫(被监督的JSON目标)来迅速使模型适应文档域和数据集所特有的JSON风格. 2. 完善:继续用剩余纪元的基本学习率,对同一套数据集进行微调. 我们在每个时代运行验证,用最低验证CER选择最佳模型(当验证CER停止在N个世纪的耐心时期改进时,早期停止应用). 我们比较了这个两阶段的时间表, 与一个单一阶段的基线 训练的相同总数 使用同位素学习率衰减。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmark of eight VLMs Across Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 不同设置的八项自愿活动基准

blocks.en: Tables 3 to 5 summarize the performance of the evaluated models on the three datasets (Erlangen-Prehistoric, Pforzheim Jewelry, Regensburg Scalalogy) under zero-shot, few-shot (1–2 examples), and fine-tuning settings, respectively. We report CER , ANLS ∗ , and mAP-F1 . Consequently, a model can achieve low CER /high ANLS ∗ yet still obtain a lower mAP-F1 if values are assigned to the wrong keys, fields are missing/merged, or extra fields are hallucinated. Notably, Donut can achieve lower CER / ANLS ∗ after fine-tuning, yet still yields 0 mAP-F1 because its outputs often fail strict JSON dict parsing (schema-incompatible/malformed).

blocks.en: Top-3 selection. Based on the overall results across the three settings (Tables 3 – 5 ), we select the top three models, Phi-3.5-Vision, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Gemma-3-4B, as they show the strongest potential for reliable structured extraction (low CER , high ANLS ∗ , and high mAP-F1 ) and stable JSON generation across datasets. Across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning, Phi-3.5-Vision, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Gemma-3-4B maintain near-saturated JSON -validity ( ≈ \approx 95 %–100 %) across datasets, reflecting stable structured generation. In the next subsection, we report additional studies and practical improvements on these selected models.
blocks.zh: 上三所选. 基于三个设置的总体结果(表3–5),我们选择了前三个模型,即Phi-3.5-Vision,Qun2.5-VL-7B,和Gemma-3-4B,因为它们显示了可靠的结构提取(低CER,高ANLS *,高mAP-F1)和稳定的JSON生成跨数据集的最大潜力. 横跨零发,多发,并微调,Phi-3.5-Vision,Quen2.5-VL-7B,和Gemma-3-4B保持了相近饱和JSON - 有效性(\\\\\\100%)跨数据集,反映了稳定的结构生成. 在下分节中,我们报告了关于这些选定模型的补充研究和实际改进。

blocks.en: 5.2 Secondary Studies on the Selected Top-3 Models
blocks.zh: 5.2 关于选定的顶级-3型模型的中级研究

blocks.en: We run three additional experiments on the selected top-3 models to test practical strategies for improving structured OCR performance. Each study is applied independently to isolate its contribution.
blocks.zh: 我们又对选定的顶-3型模型进行了三次实验,以测试改进结构化OCR性能的实际战略. 每项研究都独立应用,以隔离其贡献.

blocks.en: Study 1: Hyperparameter Optimization. Table 6 compares default fine-tuning settings against the best settings found using Optuna for each of the top-3 models.
blocks.zh: 研究1:超参数优化. 表6将默认的微调设置与使用Optuna找到的最佳设置进行对比,用于每个顶端-3型号.

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of hyperparameter optimization on the selected top-3 models across three datasets. Scores are reported after fine-tuning. All metrics are reported as percentages.
blocks.zh: 表6:超参数优化对三个数据集选定的顶-3模型的影响。 分数在微调后报告. 所有衡量标准都作为百分比报告。

blocks.en: Hyperparameter optimization generally improves performance, but the effect is not uniform across models, datasets, or metrics. The largest gains appear on the Regensburg Scalalogy dataset for all three models, while improvements on Pforzheim Jewelry dataset are comparatively small as they were already quite accurate. On Erlangen-Prehistoric dataset, hyperparameter optimization clearly benefits Qwen2.5-VL-7B, but the effect is mixed for Gemma-3-4B and Phi-3.5-Vision (e.g., some metrics improve while mAP-F1 degrade). Overall, hyperparameter optimization is a strong enhancement in several settings, but it should be evaluated empirically rather than assumed to provide consistent gains.
blocks.zh: 超参数优化一般能提高性能,但效果在模型,数据集,或度量衡之间并不统一. 最大的收益出现在所有三种模型的雷根斯堡斯卡拉克数据集上,而Pforzheim珠宝数据集的改进相对较小,因为它们已经相当准确了. 在埃尔兰根-史前数据集上,超参数优化明显有利于Quen2.5-VL-7B,但效果对Gemma-3-4B和Phi-3.5-Vision(例如,在mAP-F1降解的同时,一些度量衡有所改进)是混合的. 总体而言,超参数优化在几种情况下都是强力增强,但应该从经验上评价,而不是假设它能提供一致的收益.

blocks.en: Study 2: Image Preprocessing. Table 7 reports the effect of classical preprocessing compared to raw images for the selected top-3 models.
blocks.zh: 研究2:图像预处理. 表7汇报了古典预处理与所选上至3型号的原始图像相比的效果.

blocks.en: Table 7: Effect of image preprocessing on the selected top-3 models across three datasets. Scores are reported after fine-tuning. All metrics are reported as percentages.
blocks.zh: 表7:图像预处理对三个数据集中选定的顶-3模型的影响。 分数在微调后报告. 所有衡量标准都作为百分比报告。

blocks.en: Overall, image preprocessing shows a mixed, model- and dataset-dependent effect (Table 7 ). It improves CER for Phi-3.5-Vision on the Regensburg Scalalogy dataset (6.3 % → \rightarrow 5.5 %) and for Qwen2.5-VL-7B on the Erlangen-Prehistoric dataset (5.8 % → \rightarrow 5.2 %), but these gains do not consistently translate into better structured extraction (e.g., Phi-3.5-Vision on Regensburg Scalalogy shows lower mAP-F1 after preprocessing). In several other settings preprocessing is clearly harmful—most notably on the Erlangen-Prehistoric dataset for Phi-3.5-Vision, the Pforzheim Jewelry dataset for Gemma-3-4B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and the Regensburg Scalalogy dataset for Gemma-3-4B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,图像预处理显示出混合的,模型的和数据集的依赖效应(表7.). 它改进了Erlangen-史前数据集Phi-3.5-Vision在Regensburg Scalalogy数据集上的CER(6.3%-正线5.5%)和Erlangen-史前数据集上的Quen2.5-VL-7B(5.8%-正线5.2%),但这些增益并非始终如一地转化为更好的结构提取(例如,Regensburg Scalalogy上的Phi-3.5-Vision在预处理后显示mAP-F1更低). 在其他一些情况下,预处理显然是有害的——最显著的是Phi-3.5-Vision的Erlangen-史前数据集、Gemma-3-4B和Quen2.5-VL-7B的Pforzheim珠宝数据集和Gemma-3-4B和Quen2.5-VL-7B的Regensburg Scalalogy数据集。

blocks.en: Study 3: Multi-stage Training. Table 8 compares single-stage fine-tuning against two-stage curriculum training for the selected top-3 models.
blocks.zh: 研究3:多阶段培训。 表8将单阶段微调与选定的顶级3级模式的两阶段课程培训进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 8: Effect of multi-stage training on the selected top-3 models across three datasets. All metrics are reported as percentages.
blocks.zh: 表8:多阶段培训对三个数据集中选定的顶级-3模型的影响。 所有衡量标准都作为百分比报告。

blocks.en: In our experiments, multi-stage fine-tuning does not inherently guarantee improved accuracy; its impact is model- and dataset-dependent. From Table 8 , we observe that it consistently benefits Gemma-3-4B across all three datasets. For Phi-3.5-Vision, multi-stage notably improves Regensburg Scalalogy performance, while changes on Erlangen-Prehistoric and Pforzheim Jewelry are small and can be negative depending on the metric. For Qwen2.5-VL-7B, multi-stage yields a slight gain on Erlangen-Prehistoric but degrades performance on Pforzheim Jewelry and Regensburg Scalalogy. We therefore treat multi-stage training as an empirical enhancement and report its effect comparatively rather than assuming consistent gains.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,多阶段微调不能从本质上保证提高准确性;其影响取决于模型和数据集。 我们从表8中注意到,这在所有三个数据集中始终有利于Gemma-3-4B。 关于Phi-3.5-Vision,多阶段显著改进 Regensburg Scalalogy的性能,而埃兰根-史前和普福斯海姆珠宝上的变化是很小的,根据测量标准可以是负的. 对于Quen2.5-VL-7B,多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 因此,我们把多阶段培训视为一种经验强化,并报告其相对效果,而不是假设持续的成果。

blocks.en: 5.3 Single-Dataset vs. Multi-Dataset Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 5.3 单一数据集与多数据集 微调

blocks.en: In addition to dataset-specific fine-tuning (one checkpoint per dataset), we fine-tune each of the selected top-3 models once on the union of all training sets (Erlangen-Prehistoric + Pforzheim Jewelry + Regensburg Scalalogy) using the same standard finetune training recipe. We then evaluate this multi-dataset checkpoint on each dataset’s test set and compare it against the corresponding single-dataset checkpoint fine-tuned only on that dataset. This comparison isolates whether multi-dataset training improves generalization or introduces negative transfer across distinct schemas and text modalities.
blocks.zh: 除了针对数据集的微调(每个数据集一个检查点)外,我们还在所有培训套件(埃尔兰根-史前+普福斯海姆珠宝+雷根斯堡斯卡劳克)的联盟上,对每个被选取的顶-3型号进行了一次微调,使用相同的标准微调培训配方. 然后,我们在每个数据集的测试集上评价这个多数据集检查点,并与仅对该数据集进行微调的相应单一数据集检查点进行比较。 这种比较隔离了多数据集培训是否改进了概括性,或者在不同的计划和文本模式之间引入了负转移。

blocks.en: Table 9: Single-dataset vs. multi-dataset fine-tuning for the selected top-3 models. “Single” denotes a separate checkpoint fine-tuned per dataset; “Multi” denotes one checkpoint fine-tuned on the union of all training data and evaluated per dataset test set. All metrics are reported as percentages. ↓ \downarrow : lower is better; ↑ \uparrow : higher is better.
blocks.zh: 表9 单数据集与多数据集对所选顶-3型号进行微调. “单一”是指每个数据集对单独的检查站进行微调;“多”指对所有培训数据的结合进行微调并对每个数据集测试组进行评价的一个检查站。 所有衡量标准都作为百分比报告。 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}你觉得呢? 更低是更好的;\\ opar:更高是更好的。

blocks.en:
Overall, the effect of multi-dataset fine-tuning is clearly model-dependent rather than a uniform trade-off. For Gemma-3-4B, the multi-dataset checkpoint consistently outperforms the corresponding single-dataset checkpoints on all three datasets, improving both CER and ANLS ∗ (Table 9 ). In contrast, Qwen2.5-VL-7B shows the opposite behavior: the multi-dataset checkpoint generally degrades relative to single-dataset fine-tuning, with worse CER and ANLS ∗ on all three datasets and the strongest drop on Regensburg Scalalogy ( CER 7.6 % → \rightarrow 24.90 %, ANLS ∗ 87.0 % → \rightarrow 65.2 %).
While mAP-F1 slightly improves on Erlangen-Prehistoric (90.0 % → \rightarrow 91.9 %), it decreases on Pforzheim Jewelry (99.4 % → \rightarrow 99.1 %) and Regensburg Scalalogy (62.8 % → \rightarrow 41.4 %).
Phi-3.5-Vision also degrades under multi-dataset fine-tuning on all three datasets, but the effect is markedly smaller than for Qwen, especially on Pforzheim Jewelry ( CER 0.30 % → \rightarrow 0.50 %, ANLS ∗ 99.4 % → \rightarrow 99.2 %).
We therefore do not observe a single general rule for multi-dataset fine-tuning in this benchmark; instead, it can either improve cross-dataset robustness (Gemma) or introduce negative transfer of varying severity (Phi, Qwen) depending on the model.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,多数据集微调的效果明显依赖于模型,而不是统一的取舍. 就Gemma-3-4B而言,多数据集检查站的业绩始终高于所有三个数据集上相应的单一数据集检查站,改善了CER和ANLS*(表9)。 与此相反,Quen2.5-VL-7B显示的是相反的行为:多数据集检查点相对于单数据集微调一般会退化,所有三个数据集的CER和ANLS 都出现更差的CER和ANLS *,Regensburg Scalalog上下降得最快的(CER7.6%~\右旋24.90%,ANLS → 87.0%~\右旋65.2%).
虽然mAP-F1在埃兰根-史前学(90.0%-\右旋91.9%)上略有改进,但在普福斯海姆珠宝(99.4%-\右旋99.1%)和雷根斯堡斯卡拉克(62.8%-\右旋41.4%)上却有所下降.
Phi-3.5-Vision还对所有三个数据集进行多数据集微调后降解,但效果明显小于Quen,特别是对Pforzheim珠宝公司的影响(CER 0.30%~\右旋0.5 %;ANLS * 99.4%~\右旋 99.2%)。
因此,我们没有在这个基准中遵守一个单一的多数据集微调通则;相反,它可以改进跨数据集稳健性(Gemma),或者根据模型的不同引入不同程度的负转移(Phi,Quen).

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates a representative Erlangen-Prehistoric example for Gemma-3-4B, where fine-tuning improves field binding for inventory number and measurements, while some handwritten text and field-boundary errors remain.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了一个有代表性的Erlangen-Prehistoric的Gemma-3-4B的例子,其中微调改进了库存编号和测量的字段绑定,而一些手写文字和字段边界错误仍然存在.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison for Gemma-3-4B on an Erlangen-Prehistoric sample. Fine-tuning corrects the inventory number and measurements and reduces sample-level CER from 26.8 % to 13.9 %, while longer handwritten text and Fundort / Fundzeit separation remain challenging.
blocks.zh: 图4:埃兰根-史前样本上Gemma-3-4B的质量比较. 精细调整纠正了清单编号和测量,将样本水平的CER从26.8%减少到13.9%,而较长的手写文字和Fundort / Fundzeit分离仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We benchmarked eight lightweight VLM for document OCR with schema-guided JSON extraction across three archival datasets covering handwritten inventory books, mostly printed jewelry records, and structurally complex staircase forms. Overall, instruction-tuned general-purpose VLM (Qwen2.5-VL, Phi-3.5-Vision, and Gemma-3) are the strongest candidates, outperforming several OCR-specialized alternatives in structured generation. This indicates that reliable extraction depends not only on text recognition, but also on instruction following, field binding, and stable schema-conformant decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们把八个轻量级的VLM作为文件OCR的基准,其中包含三个档案数据集,包括手写库存书籍、大多数是印刷的珠宝记录和结构复杂的楼梯表。 总体而言,经指导调整的通用VLM(Qwen2.5-VL,Phi-3.5-Vision,和Gemma-3)是最强的候选者,在结构化生成中优于OCR的几种专业替代品. 这表明,可靠的提取不仅取决于文本识别,还取决于后续指令、字段约束和稳定的符合计划编解码。

blocks.en: Few-shot prompting is not consistently beneficial: it can help on cleaner printed records such as Pforzheim Jewelry, but remains mixed or negative on handwritten and structurally complex datasets, where longer prompts can increase instruction complexity. Fine-tuning is the most effective adaptation strategy, with full fine-tuning for sub-1B models and QLoRA for larger models enabling strong local performance on a single consumer GPU . Among the additional studies, hyperparameter optimization provides the most reliable modest gains, particularly on the more difficult Regensburg Scalalogy dataset, whereas image preprocessing and multi-stage training are strongly model- and dataset-dependent and can also degrade structured extraction.
blocks.zh: 少发点提示并非一贯有益:它可以帮助更清洁的印刷记录,如Pforzheim Jewelry,但在手写和结构复杂的数据集上仍然有混合或负分,其中较长的提示可以增加指令的复杂性. 微调是最有效的适应战略,对子-1B模型进行全面微调,对较大模型进行QLORA, 使单一消费GPU具有强大的本地性能。 在其他研究中,超参数优化提供了最可靠的微小收益,特别是在难度更大的Regensburg Scalalogy数据集上,而图像预处理和多阶段培训则高度依赖模型和数据集,也可以降解结构提取.

blocks.en: The single- versus multi-dataset experiments further show that joint training is not uniformly beneficial: Gemma-3-4B improves across all three collections, suggesting better cross-schema robustness, whereas Phi-3.5-Vision and especially Qwen2.5-VL-7B show signs of negative transfer. This highlights that deployment decisions should consider whether an institution needs one general checkpoint across collections or separate dataset-specific checkpoints for maximum accuracy.
blocks.zh: 单一和多数据集的实验进一步表明,联合培训并非一致有益: Gemma-3-4B在所有三集中都有所改进,表明交叉切变强健性更好,而Phi-3.5-Vision,尤其是Quen2.5-VL-7B则显示出负转移的迹象. 这突出表明,部署决定应考虑一个机构是否需要一个跨收集部门的一般检查站,还是需要单独的数据集专用检查站,以便尽可能准确。

blocks.en: Our study has two main limitations: we evaluate hyperparameter optimization, preprocessing, and multi-stage training independently, and the lightweight VLM landscape evolves rapidly. Thus, our findings should be read as guidance for the evaluated model families rather than an exhaustive statement about all emerging OCR/document models. Future work should explore constrained decoding for valid JSON , layout-aware field binding, handwriting-specific adaptation, broader multilingual datasets, and controlled comparisons of full fine-tuning versus QLoRA under matched compute budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有两个主要的局限性: 我们独立地评价超参数优化,预处理,以及多阶段训练,轻量级的VLM地貌迅速演化. 因此,我们的调查结果应被理解为对被评价的模范家庭的指导,而不是对所有新出现的OCR/文件模型的详尽说明。 未来的工作应探讨对有效的JSON进行限制的解码、布局意识字段的绑定、笔迹特异性的修改、更广泛的多语种数据集,以及在相匹配的计算预算下全面微调与QLORA的可控比较。
